messages:
sara_sales: FYI customer (Large Financial) asks for a sealed-site POC. They require a full dependency inventory + SBOM, proof of signed bundles, and a clear cost-lift estimate for offline delivery. They also say monthly forced upgrades are a blocker — they want a predictable quarterly cadence. Can we scope?

mike_se: Thanks. key Qs: 1) how big can the initial bundle be? 2) do they accept USB transfer or do they need a couriered HDD? 3) any HSM/KMS constraints?

sara_sales: They said USB is fine for POC but long-term they'd prefer an approved transfer channel. HSM/KMS must be customer-managed. Also they flagged third-party license audit — need SBOM.

josh_eng: We can create a signed, immutable bundle + delta patching. Two options:
- full sealed bundle (all deps) delivered once, then deltas for patches
- chunked delta-only bundles (sign each chunk)

For delta we can use binary diffs; estimated monthly delta size depends on model quantization/weights changes. For a typical model delta after quantization: ~50-150MB for tokenizer/runtime patches, but model weight deltas can be >10GB if we ship new weights. For their requirement of quarterly updates, we'd probably ship full weights only quarterly, smaller security/agent patches between.

anya_sec: For SBOM and licenses we can provide SPDX v2.2 or CycloneDX export. We'll need to redact any third-party keys but include package hashes. Also need to map each CVE to our mitigations. Customer requires signed SBOM as part of attestation.

mike_se: What's the cost lift for sealed delivery vs hosted? Rough sketch:
- Engineering packaging + signing setup: 1.5–3 FTE-weeks (one-time) 
- Manual transfer ops (USB courier) per POC: ~$500–2k depending on logistics
- Enterprise on-going: support for delta signing + offline distribution tooling + audit: license uplift (we typically add a premium on Dedicated license for sealed + on-prem support)

sara_sales: They already asked for price delta. Can we give a tighter number for SOW? They want an approximate range today.

josh_eng: Ballpark for POC (one-off): $12k–25k (engineering + packaging + ops). For annual deployment (air-gapped): add 25–40% on top of the normal Dedicated fee for the sealed packaging + higher support SLA. I'll get exact staffing estimate.

anya_sec: Also checklist for SQA / compliance questionnaire items we need filled before POC launch:
1) Approved contact + NDAs for courier ops
2) KMS/HSM integration details (cert formats)
3) Approved list of external endpoints (if any) for license validation
4) Desired upgrade cadence (they said quarterly)
5) Acceptable rollback window and time-to-patch SLO

sara_sales: Good. Can we run an internal POC plan: deliver signed bundle, run install on isolated VM, perform one offline upgrade patch during window, verify audit logs? Customer wants 2-week POC.

josh_eng: Yes. Proposed plan timeline:
- Day 0–3: gather SBOM + KMS details
- Day 4–7: build sealed bundle, sign with partner HSM
- Day 8: ship USB (POC)
- Day 9–12: install + smoke tests
- Day 13: deliver delta patch and perform offline upgrade
- Day 14: handoff + runbook

mike_se: Can you add a fallback: if model weight delta is too large for USB, we do sneekernet + supplier will provide hashed manifest and we courier multi-part HDD. Also confirm we support a manual offline license activation flow (no egress) — we do.

deploy-bot: ticket S-18291 created for sealed-site POC prep (assignee: josh_eng)

sara_sales: Action items:
- josh_eng: send packaging + cost estimate by EOD tomorrow
- anya_sec: prepare SBOM template + attestation checklist
- mike_se: draft SOW pricing range and logistics options

anya_sec: I'll also prepare a redacted SBOM example and a sample signature manifest, e.g.:
```
{ "bundle": "redwood-sealed-v1", "sha256": "sha256:9f2c...ead" }
```

josh_eng: note: if customer insists on no runtime telemetry at all, we can disable all outbound calls and strip non-essential telemetry; will add ~2 days to testing.

sara_sales: Thanks team. I'll sync with the customer and share these options. :thumbsup:
